scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --types node playwright.config.ts e2e/taskflow.spec.ts
scripts.lint: eslint client/src server/src server/test server/scripts e2e
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && npm run start -w server
scripts.build:deploy: npm run db:generate && npm run build
